title: Macropad, module on top: MX keys and a 2.0 in display
note: The front-mount macropad built: twelve MX switches soldered to the board (no plate) with DSA keycaps, a DO-35 diode in the gap beside each, the thin module soldered flat on its castellated pads above the keys, and a 2.0 in ST7789 display on a tall socket at the module's right end, its pins level with the module's display column, lying over the module and the top row of keys. The board's underside is z = 0.

fits.note: The display's board clears the top row's keycaps (it reaches over them)
fits.label: Display over the keys
